description: Hand cases for the passBy.* rows (PL.native-pass-by-rows): what core's corpus conformance/villagers/pass-by.json leaves unpinned — the contract whole (each constant's export name), the floor and round rows' null radii (core's runner reads `?? undefined`), passBy.distanceToSegment, a guard point carrying an undeclared y and a side that is not ±1, a step aside with room on one side and with a several-point path, a replay with a coarser frame, a slower and wider villager, a wider player, straightBack and no time, and the [invalid-input] boundary of every declared member of every argument (plus a replay villager with an empty path, which core would walk unread). Every expectation is computed by core's own functions at the pin (gen-bridge-pass-by-cases.mts, kept with the builder's record).

cases.name: passBy.contract: every constant keyed as core's corpus contract keys it, the name core exports it under, the measured abreast window and the side frames

sideFrames.unreal: left-handed, z up; core (x, z) = Unreal (X, Y); +1 = Unreal's Left vector (−Dir.Y, Dir.X) = the walker's RIGHT
sideFrames.godot: right-handed, y up; core (x, z) = Godot (x, z); +1 = the walker's RIGHT
sideFrames.unity: left-handed, y up; core (x, z) = Unity (x, z); +1 = the walker's LEFT
sideFrames.babylon: left-handed, y up; core (x, z) = Babylon (x, z); +1 = the walker's LEFT
